scenario.description: Campus LAN: 3 buildings within 400 m, 1,600 endpoints and PoE access points. Focus: Cat6a/MMF, 802.1Q VLANs, RSTP, single-area OSPF.

media.rationale: Selected Cat6a (10GBASE-T) because the 90 m run is within the 100 m limit defined by IEEE 802.3an; Cat6a sustains 10 Gbps at this distance without active optics.

Selected OM4 Multimode Fiber (10GBASE-SR) because the 350 m run exceeds the 100 m copper limit but remains inside the 400 m OM4 reach at 850 nm, where modal dispersion and attenuation stay within budget.

vlans.name: Staff
vlans.rationale: VLAN 10 (Staff) carries Employee wired/wireless on 10.0.4.0/23 with gateway 10.0.4.1. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated.

vlans.name: Students
vlans.rationale: VLAN 20 (Students) carries Student devices on 10.0.0.0/22 with gateway 10.0.0.1. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated.

vlans.name: Voice
vlans.rationale: VLAN 30 (Voice) carries VoIP handsets on 10.0.6.0/24 with gateway 10.0.6.1. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated. PoE is enabled on access ports for this VLAN (802.3af/at budget planned per AP).

vlans.name: Guest
vlans.rationale: VLAN 40 (Guest) carries Untrusted guest Wi-Fi on 10.0.7.0/25 with gateway 10.0.7.1. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated.

vlans.name: IoT
vlans.rationale: VLAN 50 (IoT) carries Building sensors on 10.0.7.128/26 with gateway 10.0.7.129. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated.

vlans.name: Management
vlans.rationale: VLAN 60 (Management) carries Infrastructure management on 10.0.7.192/27 with gateway 10.0.7.193. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: root (priority 4096).

routing.rationale: Selected single-area OSPF (Area 0) because the scenario contains 6 subnet(s), fewer than 50, inside one autonomous system. Link-state convergence is fast and the flat area keeps the design simple to operate.

rationales.rationale: Selected Cat6a (10GBASE-T) because the 90 m run is within the 100 m limit defined by IEEE 802.3an; Cat6a sustains 10 Gbps at this distance without active optics.

Selected OM4 Multimode Fiber (10GBASE-SR) because the 350 m run exceeds the 100 m copper limit but remains inside the 400 m OM4 reach at 850 nm, where modal dispersion and attenuation stay within budget.

rationales.condition: largest-first allocation with CIDR boundary alignment
rationales.rationale: Allocated 6 subnets from 10.0.0.0/16 using largest-first VLSM. Address-space utilisation is 3.08% and host utilisation is 75.85%.
Allocated 10.0.0.0/22 to Students: 1022 usable addresses, gateway 10.0.0.1, wildcard 0.0.3.255. Blocks are aligned and checked for overlap with all previously allocated subnets.
Allocated 10.0.4.0/23 to Staff: 510 usable addresses, gateway 10.0.4.1, wildcard 0.0.1.255. Blocks are aligned and checked for overlap with all previously allocated subnets.
Allocated 10.0.6.0/24 to Voice: 254 usable addresses, gateway 10.0.6.1, wildcard 0.0.0.255. Blocks are aligned and checked for overlap with all previously allocated subnets.
Allocated 10.0.7.0/25 to Guest: 126 usable addresses, gateway 10.0.7.1, wildcard 0.0.0.127. Blocks are aligned and checked for overlap with all previously allocated subnets.
Allocated 10.0.7.128/26 to IoT: 62 usable addresses, gateway 10.0.7.129, wildcard 0.0.0.63. Blocks are aligned and checked for overlap with all previously allocated subnets.
Allocated 10.0.7.192/27 to Management: 30 usable addresses, gateway 10.0.7.193, wildcard 0.0.0.31. Blocks are aligned and checked for overlap with all previously allocated subnets.

Selected single-area OSPF (Area 0) because the scenario contains 6 subnet(s), fewer than 50, inside one autonomous system. Link-state convergence is fast and the flat area keeps the design simple to operate.

rationales.condition: segmentation by function with explicit trunk policy
rationales.rationale: VLAN 10 (Staff) carries Employee wired/wireless on 10.0.4.0/23 with gateway 10.0.4.1. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated.

rationales.rationale: VLAN 30 (Voice) carries VoIP handsets on 10.0.6.0/24 with gateway 10.0.6.1. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated. PoE is enabled on access ports for this VLAN (802.3af/at budget planned per AP).

rationales.condition: segmentation by function with explicit trunk policy
rationales.rationale: VLAN 40 (Guest) carries Untrusted guest Wi-Fi on 10.0.7.0/25 with gateway 10.0.7.1. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated.

rationales.condition: segmentation by function with explicit trunk policy
rationales.rationale: VLAN 50 (IoT) carries Building sensors on 10.0.7.128/26 with gateway 10.0.7.129. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: designated.

rationales.condition: segmentation by function with explicit trunk policy
rationales.rationale: VLAN 60 (Management) carries Infrastructure management on 10.0.7.192/27 with gateway 10.0.7.193. Trunks permit only VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 999; native VLAN 999 is reserved and unused to prevent double-tagged VLAN hopping. RSTP role: root (priority 4096).

rationales.condition: loop prevention with deterministic root selection
rationales.rationale: Selected Rapid PVST+ with per-VLAN root priority 4096 on the management VLAN so that each VLAN has a deterministic root and sub-second reconvergence after a topology change.
Selected dual-uplink design with a paired gateway peer because the scenario requests resilience beyond a single uplink. HSRP/VRRP removes the gateway as a single point of failure.

configs.switches.cfg:
! NetArchitect generated switch configuration
! Profile: campus-lan
! Review interface names, port counts, and PoE budgets before applying.
!
hostname campus-lan-sw1
!
ip routing
!
! --- VLAN database ---
vlan 10
 name STAFF
!
vlan 20
 name STUDENTS
!
vlan 30
 name VOICE
!
vlan 40
 name GUEST
!
vlan 50
 name IOT
!
vlan 60
 name MANAGEMENT
!
vlan 999
 name NATIVE_UNUSED
!
! --- Spanning tree ---
spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst
spanning-tree vlan 60 priority 4096
!
! Resiliency: dual-uplink. Deploy paired distribution switches and an HSRP/VRRP gateway peer.
!
! --- VLAN gateways (SVIs) ---
interface Vlan10
 description Staff gateway
 ip address 10.0.4.1 255.255.254.0
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan20
 description Students gateway
 ip address 10.0.0.1 255.255.252.0
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan30
 description Voice gateway
 ip address 10.0.6.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan40
 description Guest gateway
 ip address 10.0.7.1 255.255.255.128
 ip access-group GUEST_ISOLATION in
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan50
 description IoT gateway
 ip address 10.0.7.129 255.255.255.192
 no shutdown
!
interface Vlan60
 description Management gateway
 ip address 10.0.7.193 255.255.255.224
 no shutdown
!
! --- Uplink trunk (explicit allowed VLANs) ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description Uplink trunk to distribution/core
 switchport trunk encapsulation dot1q
 switchport mode trunk
 switchport trunk native vlan 999
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,20,30,40,50,60,999
 switchport nonegotiate
 no shutdown
!
! --- Access ports (sample; expand to match endpoint count) ---
interface GigabitEthernet1/0/1
 description Access - Staff
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
 spanning-tree portfast
 spanning-tree bpduguard enable
!

 description Access - Staff
 switchport mode access
 switchport access vlan 10
 spanning-tree portfast
 spanning-tree bpduguard enable
!

 switchport access vlan 20

!

configs.router.cfg:
! NetArchitect generated router configuration
! Profile: campus-lan
!
hostname campus-lan-rtr
!
! --- LAN trunk and VLAN subinterfaces ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description LAN trunk to L3 switch
 no ip address
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.10
 description Staff gateway
 encapsulation dot1Q 10
 ip address 10.0.4.1 255.255.254.0
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.20
 description Students gateway
 encapsulation dot1Q 20
 ip address 10.0.0.1 255.255.252.0
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.30
 description Voice gateway
 encapsulation dot1Q 30
 ip address 10.0.6.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.40
 description Guest gateway
 encapsulation dot1Q 40
 ip address 10.0.7.1 255.255.255.128
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.50
 description IoT gateway
 encapsulation dot1Q 50
 ip address 10.0.7.129 255.255.255.192
 no shutdown
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0.60
 description Management gateway
 encapsulation dot1Q 60
 ip address 10.0.7.193 255.255.255.224
 no shutdown
!
! --- OSPF ---
router ospf 1
 router-id 10.0.0.1
 passive-interface default
 no passive-interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 network 10.0.0.0 0.0.3.255 area 0
 network 10.0.4.0 0.0.1.255 area 0
 network 10.0.6.0 0.0.0.255 area 0
 network 10.0.7.0 0.0.0.127 area 0
 network 10.0.7.128 0.0.0.63 area 0
 network 10.0.7.192 0.0.0.31 area 0
!
end
configs.acl.cfg:
! NetArchitect generated guest isolation ACL
! Applied inbound on guest SVIs (see switches.cfg).
ip access-list extended GUEST_ISOLATION
 remark Block guest VLANs from internal address space
 deny ip any 10.0.0.0 0.0.255.255
 deny ip any 10.0.0.0 0.255.255.255
 deny ip any 172.16.0.0 0.15.255.255
 deny ip any 192.168.0.0 0.0.255.255
 permit udp any any eq 53
 permit tcp any any eq 443
 permit ip any any
!
end
